info.name: Single Point — MVP-1 … MVP-7
info.description:
End-to-end walkthrough of the MVP-1 API: resident onboarding, ticket lifecycle, admin triage, provider workflow, super-admin onboarding.

Run the requests top to bottom the first time — each folder's scripts capture the tokens / ids the next requests need into collection variables.

Local defaults: backend on http://localhost:18080, dev OTP mode ON (the code is returned in `devCode`).

request.description: Set `inviteCode` from the backend startup banner (or the Admin > Create invite code request). Leave it blank to submit a join request for admin approval instead.

request.description: A fresh number with no invite code. The session comes back with onboardingState NEEDS_PROFILE, then READY after the profile is set — activeTenantId stays null.
onboardingState is now READY with activeTenantId null — a community-less resident.
With no active tenant, GET /providers returns every Super-Admin-verified assignable provider, contact-free (no phone/email).

item.name: Individual · book a provider directly (no community)

request.description: providerId is required (400 otherwise). Books tenant-free — requestMode DIRECT_SERVICE, straight to ASSIGNED. No admin, no quota, no payment.
RLS (app.current_user_id GUC) scopes the list to the caller's own tenant-less rows. A community admin gets 404 on the same ticket id.
Run after the provider accepts → marks in-progress → resolves.
Phones are resolved to app_user ids at submit time and frozen. All-unknown phones → 400. Named individuals may be community-less.

item.name: Offers · approve targeting a set of communities (TENANT_LIST)

request.description: The Super Admin can override the audience at approval. Residents of every listed community are fanned out.
Any resident who can fetch the offer may rate it (1–5). One row per (offer, user) — a second POST upserts. Comment is encrypted at rest.

item.name: Offers · author reads the feedback list

request.description: Offer author (provider/admin) or Super Admin only — a different provider gets 404. Returns { ratingAvg, ratingCount, items[] }.

item.name: Offers · redemptions remaining on the view

request.description: When offer.redemptionLimitTotal is set, each OfferView carries redemptionsRemaining (0 once the global cap is hit). redeem() now takes a pessimistic lock.
Every state-changing admin/provider call + every @AuditRead PII read. Paged, created_at DESC. Actor + community names hydrated, phone masked. SUPER_ADMIN only (an admin token gets 403).
Each row has success=false and its errorCode (e.g. SP-404, SP-403).

item.name: Audit · by action + community + time window

request.description: action is a case-insensitive substring of "<Controller>#<method>". All filters optional and combinable.

item.name: Audit · distinct actions (for the filter UI)
Announce · admin -> residents of the acting community

request.description: COMMUNITY scope, fixed to the admin's active community. One notification_outbox row fanned out to every ACTIVE resident (push + in-app). Rate-limited: a second send inside 60s -> 429; 20/day cap.
Only the acting community's history.
Reaches every account, including community-less individuals.

item.name: Announce · Super Admin -> a named community
Announce · Super Admin history (optionally one scope)

request.description: Announcements are opt-out (default on). A muted resident's next broadcast is recorded SKIPPED ("broadcasts muted"), never pushed.
Tickets bucketed by status + resident action items: pendingApprovalCount, resolvedAwaitingCloseCount, pendingPaymentCount, activeOffersCount.
awaitingAcceptCount (ASSIGNED, not yet accepted) + ratingAvg/ratingCount.
Tenant-scoped ticket buckets + unassignedCount + slaBreachedCount + pendingJoinRequestsCount.
Platform-wide totals incl. communityLessOpenTickets, providersPendingVerificationCount, offersPendingApprovalCount, communityCount.

item.name: Device binding · verify OTP on this device

request.description: X-Device-Id is optional but, when sent, gets baked into the minted token's deviceId claim.

item.name: Device binding · call with the matching device

request.description: Succeeds — the header matches the token's claim.

item.name: Device binding · call with no / a different device → 401

request.description: A token minted with a deviceId claim is rejected (SP-401-DEVICE) when the header is missing or different — the client falls back to a fresh OTP sign-in, which binds a new token to this device. A token with no claim (no header was ever sent) is never gated.

item.name: Device binding · refresh preserves the binding

request.description: The re-minted token is still bound to the same device.

item.name: Paid community-less · provider charges a resolved booking

request.description: Only the assigned provider can charge — there is no admin for a community-less ticket. Works now that PaymentService.requireTicket has a null-tenant fallback.

Paid community-less · digital receipt (tenant_id is null)

request.description: Creates a PENDING_REVIEW tenant (invisible to residents / tenantHealth). 409 if the caller already has one pending or already manages a community.
The caller's latest request, or null.
Requester hydrated + phone masked.
Tenant -> ACTIVE, the requester becomes ADMIN (+ admin_tenant link, a "Main" location), COMMUNITY_APPROVED notification. They pick up the ADMIN role on their next /auth/refresh.
Tenant -> ARCHIVED, requester stays RESIDENT, notified with the reason.
12 weekly points {ticketsCreated, ticketsResolved, offersRedeemed, newUsers, revenue} + now-totals {communities, activeCommunities, residents, providers, openTickets, mrr}. SUPER_ADMIN only.
